content.short: TheStandard.io provides 0% interest borrowing while earning yield on your collateral portfolio.
content.description: Earn a strong crypto yield while borrowing and preserving custody of your private keys. With 0% interest on loans, you can unlock liquidity and earn yield on a diversified set of collateral, all while keeping full control of your assets. Use multiple crypto types as collateral, and trade or swap collateral even while you have an outstanding loan. Everything happens within one Smart Vault, delivering yield, liquidity, and complete asset control in a single secure solution.
